item.title: Dijkstra: shortest route on a directed road network
item.description: How I implemented Dijkstra’s algorithm in Java on a road network of 8 cities on Zealand with weighted, directed roads, and how I visualized it step by step.

item.title: A*: shortest route between cities on a grid
item.description: How I implemented A* in Java on a 12×12 grid with 8 named cities, using Manhattan distance as the heuristic, and how the visualization compares it with Dijkstra.
